|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Whenever opponent forfeits a character or unpiloted starship at same system or sector as your Imperial capital starship, you may draw destiny. If destiny > target's destiny number, you may capture that character or starship. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Besieged (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. If opponent just forfeited a character or unpiloted starship at same system or sector as your Imperial capital starship, you may draw destiny. Character or starship is captured if destiny > its destiny number. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “Whenever” → “If”; “forfeits” → “just forfeited”; “If” → “Character or starship is captured if”; “target's” → “its”; “number, you may capture that character or starship. [Immune” → “number. (Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 30. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Besieged]].
* Later text: [[Besieged (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Besieged (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Besieged]].
